monicaImport.title: Import from Monica
monicaImport.description: Import contacts, activities, notes, reminders and relationships from a Monica CRM instance via its API. Calls, tasks, gifts and debts can be brought over as notes.

connect.description: Import your contacts, activities, notes, reminders and relationships from a running Monica instance. Create an API token in Monica under Settings → API.
connect.tokenHelp: How to get an API token
connect.includeRelationships: Import relationships (slower: needs one request per contact)
connect.collapseReciprocalHelp: Monica saves every relationship on both contacts. Meerkat needs only one entry — the other contact shows it under "Incoming Relationships". Turn this off to create a separate entry on each contact, as Monica does.
connect.includeExtras: Import calls, tasks, gifts and debts as notes
connect.estimate: Estimated fetch time: about {{duration}} (Monica limits API requests)

calendarSync.title: Calendar Sync
calendarSync.description: Import events from CalDAV or iCalendar (.ics) calendars as activities. Attendees whose email addresses match your contacts are linked automatically.
calendarSync.dialogInfo: Events are matched to your contacts via the attendees' email addresses. Calendars sync automatically every 6 hours (default); you can also sync manually at any time. Note: if an upcoming event is changed in your calendar, it may occasionally be imported again as a duplicate activity.
calendarSync.saveError: Failed to save the calendar subscription.
calendarSync.deleteError: Failed to delete the calendar subscription.
calendarSync.syncError: Calendar sync failed. Please check the URL and credentials.
calendarSync.name: Name
calendarSync.urlHelp: CalDAV collection URL or a direct link to an .ics file (webcal:// also works).

calendarSync.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the stored password
calendarSync.deleteConfirm: Remove “{{name}}”? Activities that were already imported will be kept.
